budget_items.what_was_recorded: A trustee said the Friday-hours request is small relative to big-ticket town items and should go through the normal budgeting process, July 2022.
budget_items.quote: even though the $18k for a half year, $35k for the full year is a relatively small request, we should wait and go through the normal budgeting process

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director reported the revolving fund is 40% less than last year, with the full impact not yet known.
budget_items.quote: muir said that the revolving fund is 40% less than it was last year but that the impact isn't fully known yet.

budget_items.topic: Budget status and FY2023 budget process

budget_items.quote: we are in the 4th month of the fiscal year and the budget is one third expended.
